style: clean / minimal / premium product-design portfolio cover — SPARC's design system RECREATED natively in HTML/CSS (no screenshots, no mockup images). Crisp DOM dashboard cards, real site copy, real tokens, inline-SVG sparklines, over a slow-drifting blurred green gradient stage. Slow confident glides, power/sine easing only; zero gimmicks, zero narration. Reads as a poster at thumbnail size: big type, big number, high contrast.
font_note: Site fonts are Adobe-licensed and NOT in the capture. Display 'good-times' (wide techy geometric) → fallback Michroma (Google; Orbitron acceptable alt). Body 'nimbus-sans' → 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif. All recreated text must stay thumbnail-readable: headline lines ≥ ~84px, MPI number ≥ ~120px, card labels ≥ ~20px, nothing smaller than ~18px rendered.

assets_resolved.logo_lockup: assets/capture/assets/hero-2.png (only bitmap in the piece — it's the logo, allowed)
ui_source_of_truth: assets/capture/extracted/tokens.json — real CSS variables: --neutrals--black #0c0c0c, surfaces #141414/#252525, --primary-green--green-10 #b5f542, green-20 #c3f76394, green-30 #b5f54266, green-35 #b5f54226, green-50 #0d1a0e (deep green), neutrals-50 #8a8a8a, radii 8/12/16/20px, --text-color--text-green

phone SPARC Insight card — cut to stay inside the 3-moment budget

content.capture: resolved — UI is recreated natively from extracted tokens/copy; no page screenshots composited

customize.shimmer-sweep: single restrained diagonal sheen across the MPI card at 5.4–6.1s; low opacity (~0.10), white→transparent; once, never repeats
customize.vignette: polish block, very subtle (~0.2) — keeps corners reading dark at thumbnail size
customize.note: no catalog block covers a native-UI dashboard cover; choreography hand-authored per blueprints dataviz-countup + titlecard-reveal restraint, rules: counting-dynamic-scale (MPI count-up), svg-path-draw (sparkline draw-on), depth-scatter-assemble, depth-of-field-blur, ambient-glow-bloom, sine-wave-loop; motion-vocabulary primitives slide_bottom / word_reveal / fade_blur / scale_grow / scale_pulse / hold_breath

stage_background.description: Blurred green gradient stage — the green glow SPARC uses behind its hero, not a neon wash. Built from CSS gradient divs with filter: blur() (render-safe; NO backdrop-filter).
blobs: blob-1 (deep green): ~1400px radial div, #0d1a0e at ~85% → transparent, filter blur(140px), centered behind the dashboard cluster (≈ x 1350, y 560)
blob-2 (lime glow): ~900px radial div, #b5f542 at 10% opacity (≈ token green-35 #b5f54226) → transparent, blur(160px), upper-left behind lockup/headline (≈ x 380, y 260)
blob-3 (deep green): ~1100px radial div, #0d1a0e at ~70% → transparent, blur(140px), lower-left (≈ x 300, y 980)
stage_background.motion: each blob drifts on sine-wave-loop the full 7s: ±30–45px x/y, periods 9–13s, phase-offset; opacity blooms 0→full during 0.0–0.9s (ambient-glow-bloom). Slow enough to read as living light, near zero-crossing at t=7 for the loop.
stage_background.vignette: subtle, on top of blobs, below UI

left_column (branding + hero copy).headline: BUILD MENTALLY STRONGER TEAMS — Michroma 700, uppercase, 3 stacked lines ~92px, white; the word STRONGER in lime #b5f542 (site's --text-color--text-green pattern); left-aligned, starts ≈ y 380
left_column (branding + hero copy).cta: lime pill (radius-full), #b5f542 bg, #0c0c0c text 'Request a Demo' in body stack ~22px/600, ~64px tall, below headline

dashboard_cluster (right, native DOM car.card_MPI: ≈ 460×340 at (x 1290, y 430), frontmost. Label 'Mental Performance Index' ~20px #8a8a8a; hero number 84 ~130px white Michroma with '/100' ~28px #8a8a8a; thin lime progress ring or arc at 84%
dashboard_cluster (right, native DOM car.card_trends: ≈ 520×360 at (x 1560, y 700), scale 0.92 (reads farther back). Title 'Team Assessment Trends' ~22px white. Three rows, each: label ~20px white + inline-SVG sparkline (lime stroke 3px, transparent fill) + value: 'Managing Pressure — 30', 'Focus & Concentration — 36' with a lime '+4' delta chip (green-35 bg, lime text), 'Handling Frustration — 42'. Sparkline path shapes echo the site's 30/36/42/38/28/28-style series
dashboard_cluster (right, native DOM car.card_insights: ≈ 380×180 at (x 1170, y 210), scale 0.88, back layer. Pill tag 'AI-Powered Insights' (lime text on green-35 bg) + title 'Weekly AI Insights' ~24px white + two skeleton text bars (#252525, radius 8) — no tiny paragraph text

recreated_ui.z_order: blobs (z0) → vignette (z0.5) → card_insights (z1) → card_trends (z1.5) → card_MPI (z2) → left column lockup/headline/CTA (z3)

choreography.name: Brand + headline strike (hook)
layers: 0.00–0.90s — gradient blobs bloom: opacity 0→full, scale 1.08→1.0, sine.out (ambient-glow-bloom); their perpetual sine drift starts immediately.
0.15–0.60s — SPARC lockup resolves: fade_blur (opacity 0→1, blur 12px→0), no movement.

0.35–1.30s — headline word_reveal by line: each of the 3 lines slide_bottom (y +90→0, opacity 0→1, power4.out, 0.12s stagger); 'STRONGER' lands already lime — the sub-0.5s hook is line 1 + lime glow on black.

choreography.name: Dashboard glide-in + MPI count-up
layers: 1.90–3.00s — card_MPI enters from right: x +140→0, y +30→0, blur 8px→0, opacity 0→1, power4.out (settles just after beat 2.0).
2.10–3.20s — card_trends depth-scatter-assemble from lower-right (x +100 y +60 → 0, settles at scale 0.92), 0.2s stagger.
2.30–3.40s — card_insights same recipe from upper-left of the cluster, settles at scale 0.88.
2.20–3.50s — MPI number counts 0→84 (counting-dynamic-scale; timeline-driven snap so it's seek-safe) while the lime ring arc sweeps 0→84% (svg-path-draw on the arc), both power2.out ending together.

choreography.name: Sparklines draw on (pattern interrupt)
layers: 4.00–5.10s — the three trend sparklines draw on via stroke-dashoffset (svg-path-draw), 0.45s each, 0.15s stagger, power2.inOut — the piece's signature micro-moment.
4.20s (beat 4.2) — CTA pill scale_pulse: scale 1→1.05→1, 0.35s, sine.inOut — the single accent hit; nothing else reacts.
5.00–5.35s — '+4' delta chip on Focus & Concentration: scale_grow (0.8→1.0, opacity 0→1, power3.out) — the last new element.

choreography.name: Poster hold (loop-friendly)
layers: 5.40–7.00s — three cards hand off to sine-wave-loop ambient float: ±5px y, periods 5.5s/4.8s/6.2s, phase-offset, amplitude eased in from 0; blobs keep their slow drift.
5.40–7.00s — left column hold_breath: scale 1.000→1.010, sine.inOut, one slow inhale.
5.40–6.10s — shimmer-sweep: one diagonal sheen crosses card_MPI (~0.10 opacity). Frame is otherwise still by 6.1s.

7.00s — end frame = recreated_ui layout exactly: lockup + full headline + CTA left, three lit dashboard cards right, 84/100 and drawn sparklines resolved, green glow breathing. Ambient offsets near zero-crossing at t=7; final frame doubles as the card's poster.

content.easing_language: entrances power4.out / power3.out (long deceleration, premium weight); count-up and draws power2; accents sine.inOut; nothing bounces, no back/elastic; no cut faster than 0.35s

highlights.region: hero headline 'BUILD MENTALLY STRONGER TEAMS' + Request a Demo CTA
Team Assessment Trends sparklines (draw-on) + Weekly AI Insights card

builder_notes: NO screenshots/mockup bitmaps for UI — every card, headline, pill, and sparkline is DOM/SVG built from tokens.json values (#0c0c0c / #141414 / #252525 / #b5f542 / #b5f54226 / #0d1a0e / #8a8a8a, radii 8/12/16/20). Only bitmap allowed: hero-2.png lockup.

Blurred stage = gradient divs with filter: blur() — do NOT use backdrop-filter (render-unsafe). Oversize blob divs beyond canvas edges to avoid blur edge clipping; mark the drifting blob wrapper data-layout-allow-overflow.
Count-up and sparkline/arc draws must be timeline-driven (GSAP snap on textContent / stroke-dashoffset tweens), fully seek-safe and deterministic — no rAF counters, no Math.random.
Load Michroma via local @font-face (freeze the woff2 into assets/) — no runtime Google Fonts fetch at render; body text uses the Helvetica/Arial system stack.
Text sizes: headline ~92px, MPI 130px, labels ≥20px — verify thumbnail legibility at 480px-wide preview.
Every timed element: class='clip' + data-start/data-duration/data-track-index; single paused timeline registered on window.__timelines; run npm run check before handoff.

shot_brief: A 7s unnarrated 16:9 poster-in-motion, rebuilt natively: SPARC's UI recreated as crisp DOM over a slow-breathing blurred green gradient stage (deep green #0d1a0e + low-opacity lime blobs on #0c0c0c). Blobs bloom from black as the SPARC lockup resolves and the headline BUILD MENTALLY STRONGER TEAMS reveals line by line — STRONGER in lime — with a lime Request-a-Demo pill (hook <0.5s). Three real dashboard cards glide in from the right at parallax depths while the Mental Performance Index counts 0→84 and its lime ring sweeps. Then the signature micro-moment: three sparklines draw themselves across the Team Assessment Trends card and a lime +4 chip lands. Everything settles into phase-offset ambient float, one sheen crosses the MPI card, and the piece holds a composed, loop-safe poster frame. Dominant motion idea: living green light behind a calm, self-assembling dashboard — the site's design system doing the talking, in vector-crisp DOM.
